Tabletop / high-contrast background.primary_failure_mechanism: Tabletop grain, hearth ash, patterned cloth tablecloths, or laptop keyboard keys introduce background clutter.

White egg on white tray / fridge interio.primary_failure_mechanism: Near-zero photometric contrast between white eggshell and white plastic tray or paper bag; Otsu floods background.

Egg on container / lid / plain surface.primary_failure_mechanism: Plastic food-container lids, bowls, metal pans, or plain packaging surfaces create perimeter reflections and false components.

Hand holding egg / fingers occluding.primary_failure_mechanism: Fingers or palm occlude egg perimeter; skin tone overlaps shadow gradient, distending contour into hand.

Egg in boiling water / submerged.primary_failure_mechanism: Bubbling cavitation, water refraction, and dark pot rims break convex boundary and flood liquid.

Multiple touching eggs.primary_failure_mechanism: Touching or adjacent instances share continuous boundary; requires distance watershed marker separation.

Foliage / herbs in background (specular.primary_failure_mechanism: Egg contrasts against dark foliage in grayscale; specular leaf reflections create occasional false blobs.

Backlit / extreme shadows.primary_failure_mechanism: High-intensity directional backlight causes glowing core while shell perimeter falls into dark silhouette.
